  • Fractionation volumes, increments, cycle count, endpoints and fraction-retention choices are unreported.

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • Eq. 1 and the fit define R_av as mean radius and sigma as radius-distribution standard deviation, but one prose sentence calls the reported R_av values diameters.
  • Main text describes Figure 1C particles dispersed in hexane; the SI SAXS method specifies cyclohexane.
